content:
Motivated by giving a Zoom talk at the workshop in Beijing this week, I have made a few videos on Metaprogramming and posted a YouTube Playlist. These are unpolished but I hope may be of some use. The code is on github.

I will keep adding to this list (two more are planned in the short run, to illustrate TryThis and liftMetaTactic). Please suggest any specific topic you would like addressed (if I am competent to do this).
Thank you so much. These rough videos are harder on the author to put up, especially if you have high personal standards, but they’re the reality of problem solving: most of it is unsexy
